mergeInto.name: Semantic Kernel
mergeInto.description: Open-source Microsoft SDK and runtime for building, orchestrating and deploying production AI agents and multi-agent workflows.
mergeInto.useCase: For developers starting new Microsoft-oriented agent systems with tools, workflows, multiple model providers and operational controls.
mergeInto.reason: Microsoft identifies Agent Framework as the direct successor to Semantic Kernel and provides a current Semantic Kernel migration guide. Keeping Semantic Kernel as a separate recommended active framework would duplicate a superseded maintenance-line identity for new projects.
mergeInto.userValue: Microsoft Agent Framework is the current Microsoft framework for new production agent development, unifying the lineage of Semantic Kernel and AutoGen.
